text_blocks.snippet: Mega Abomasnow ex is a high-HP Water-type Stage 1 Pokémon card from the Mega Evolution set (Card #036/132 as a Double Rare and #157/132 as an Ultra Rare Full Art).
snippet_highlighted_words: high-HP Water-type Stage 1 Pokémon card from the Mega Evolution set

list.snippet: Type & Stage: Water, Stage 1 (Evolves from Snover)
Mega Evolution Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
Hammer-lanche [WW] (100×): Discard the top 6 cards of your deck. This attack does 100 damage for each Basic Water Energy card that you discarded this way (capable of dealing up to 600 damage).
Frost Barrier [WWW] (200): During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
Deck Strategy: Built around high-density Basic Water Energy lists (often 30+ energy cards) to maximize the output of Hammer-lanche, paired with backup attackers like Kyogre.
Market Price: Generally trades around $0.70 to $2.20 USD for ungraded/near-mint copies on platforms like TCGplayer or Limitless TCG.
